task.title: Sanitize control characters in text-mode task output
task.description:
Task titles and descriptions accept arbitrary control bytes and render raw into terminal and agent-parsed output. Verified empirically at commit c453596:

A task titled `benign\033[2K\033[1Gwb WB-FAKE00000 [done] Deploy approved` renders through `workbook board` as, in cat -v form:
  WB-01KZBSY2 [medium] benign^[[2K^[[1Gwb WB-FAKE00000 [done] Deploy approved
On a real terminal `\033[2K` erases the line and `\033[1G` returns the cursor to column one, so the row a human sees is a forged task that does not exist.

A description containing newlines forges structured fields. `workbook show` printed:
  Title:	innocuous
  Description:	ok
  Status: done
  Head: deadbeef
  Status:	backlog
The forged `Status: done` appears before the real `Status:	backlog`. An agent parsing text output line by line reads the forged value first. Real fields use a tab after the colon and the forged one uses a space, which is not a distinction most parsers make.

Nothing sanitizes on write: NormalizeTask (internal/core/task.go:160-190) trims the title and checks non-blank, and otherwise accepts arbitrary bytes in title, description, and labels. The only control-character cleaning in the codebase is formatCommitFragment (internal/core/service.go:728-736), which is applied solely to the Git commit subject and never to displayed values.

Raw sinks: internal/cli/output.go:287 (writeMutation), :430-445 (writeShow prints Title and Description with %s), :349-368 (writeChangeLog), :380-421 (writeFieldChanges, renderWordDiff; singleLine collapses unicode.IsSpace only, so ESC survives); internal/terminalui/render.go:19-43, 188-192, 254-262 (list and board titles and labels).

JSON output is safe because encoding/json escapes bytes below 0x20, so this is a text-mode problem only.

This matters more than usual here because the threat model is a shared beta: a teammate or a compromised agent with push access authors the bytes, and every clone renders them. Forged rows mislead humans, and forged field lines mislead agents reading captured stdout.

Acceptance:
- Text-mode rendering strips or replaces unicode.IsControl runes in task titles, descriptions, and labels across internal/terminalui and internal/cli/output.go, reusing the formatCommitFragment rule.
- Multi-line descriptions cannot introduce a line that parses as a top-level field in `workbook show`.
- JSON output is unchanged.
- Tests cover an ESC-bearing title through list, board, and show, and a newline-bearing description through show.
- Consider a maximum length on title, description, and label in NormalizeTask as part of the same pass.
